backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the animal welfare donation platform backend, including donor profile management, campaign CRUD (admin-only), donation recording, and recurring donation support with access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (visual theme, donor profiles, campaign listings, donation submission) to their corresponding source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose and contents of each component, page, hook, and utility.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for Home, CampaignDetail, Profile, and DonationHistory, and renders a layout with auth-aware profile setup modal and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/CampaignCard.tsx: Clickable card component displaying a campaign's cover image, status badge, animal type, title, fundraising progress bar, raised/goal amounts, and days remaining.
Filter UI component providing status toggle buttons (All/Active/Completed) and animal type badge filters for narrowing the campaign listing.
frontend/src/components/CampaignProgress: Displays a campaign's fundraising progress with a progress bar, percentage, raised amount, donor count, and days remaining, including urgency banners for campaigns ending soon or already ended.
frontend/src/components/DonationForm.tsx: Renders a donation form with preset and custom amount inputs and a recurring toggle, handling authentication state, form submission to the backend, and success/error callbacks.
frontend/src/components/DonationHistoryL: Shows a sorted list of a user's past donations with campaign title, date, reference ID, amount, and a receipt button, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/DonationSuccessM: A modal dialog shown after a successful donation, displaying campaign name, amount, recurring status, and a copyable transaction reference ID.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the app shell with a sticky header containing the PawFund logo, navigation links, and an authenticated user dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A blocking modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to create their donor profile by entering a display name and optional avatar URL.
frontend/src/components/ReceiptModal.tsx: A dialog modal component that displays a formatted donation receipt including donor name, campaign, amount, date, recurring status, and a copyable transaction reference ID.
frontend/src/components/RecentDonors.tsx: A card component that lists the 10 most recent donors for a given campaign, showing avatar initials, name, date, and amount, with loading skeleton and empty states.
frontend/src/components/RecurringDonatio: A card component that fetches and displays the user's active recurring donations with campaign titles, amounts, and a cancel button for each entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the backend actor, covering user profiles, campaigns, and donations (submit, recurring, cancel) with appropriate cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind, and defines light/dark CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens along with utility classes like paw-gradient and card-hover.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides shared utility functions including Tailwind class merging, currency/date formatting, days-remaining calculation, and animal emoji mapping.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CampaignDetail.tsx: Campaign detail page that displays a single campaign's cover image, progress, donor count, and donation form, with a success modal on completed donations.
frontend/src/pages/DonationHistory.tsx: Authenticated page listing a user's past donations with the ability to view and download receipts via a modal; redirects unauthenticated users to log in.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page showing a hero banner, search input, animal-type/status filters, and a responsive grid of campaign cards with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Authenticated profile page displaying donor stats, an editable nickname/avatar, and a list of recurring donations; prompts unauthenticated users to log in.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL query parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining a warm/earthy color palette using oklch CSS variables, custom fonts (Nunito, Lora), border radii, box shadows, animations, and plugins (typography, container-queries, animate).
project_state.json: Project state descriptor for a PawFund donation app, capturing schema version, architectural notes, existing feature definitions (theming, donor profiles, campaigns, donations, recurring donations), and image requirements for assets.
